My teaching philosophy centers on bridging the gap between theoretical engineering principles and hands-on, practical application. Whether guiding students through complex polyphase power systems or modular robotics design, I believe in fostering an interactive and highly accessible learning environment. 

By integrating modern computational tools, custom gamified simulations, and real-world project-based learning, my goal is to empower the next generation of engineers to approach problem-solving with confidence, creativity, and analytical rigor.
